summary: Ituran Location & Control Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, attaching a press release and proxy statement announcing its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held November 12, 2026 at its Fort Lauderdale, Florida offices. Shareholders of record as of October 5, 2026 will vote on receiving audited 2025 financial statements, renewing auditor Fahn Kanne (Grant Thornton), electing Class B directors Nir Sheratzky, Yigal Shani and Yehuda Kahane, and re-electing external director Israel Baron. The board recommends FOR all items. This is a routine AGM notice, not a special situation.
